result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would eliminate the fear of difference. Not just tolerance, but genuine celebration of diversity—in thought, identity, culture, and belief. Fear of the "other" fuels so much suffering: wars, oppression, discrimination, and even the quiet loneliness of isolation. If people could see each other not as threats but as mirrors—each reflecting a unique piece of the human experience—we might finally prioritize connection over division.

It wouldn’t solve everything, but it would make everything solvable.
